paper.title_en: Soliton solution of a gravitating chiral quark soliton model: dynamical fermion and Dirac-sea in general relativity
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we study Einstein-Dirac system based on a Dirac fermion coupled with a nonlinear chiral field on static spherically symmetric spacetime. Gravitational effects on the dynamical mass of fermions are examined. The chiral quark soliton model (CQSM) originally was a model of hadron inspired by the low-energy regime of large-$N_\textrm{c}$ QCD, realizing localized fermions with the full inclusion of the Dirac-sea, which is derived from a regularized one-fermion loop. We extend the CQSM in spherically symmetric curved spacetime and coupled with the Einstein gravity. We successfully solve the CQSM and the Einstein equation self-consistently, and obtain the spectral flow of the fermion energies and also of the ADM mass. The Dirac-sea dilutes the effect of the energy-momentum tensor, which induces an inactive point for the impact of gravity even when the localizing matter exists. The Dirac-sea effect becomes dominant for larger dynamical mass $M\sim \langle\barψψ\rangle$, leading to the emergence of the negative ADM mass.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在球对称弯曲时空中将手征夸克孤子模型（CQSM）与Einstein引力耦合，自洽求解Einstein-Dirac系统，考察引力对费米子动力学质量的影响，涉及ADM质量与谱流等广义相对论基础议题；理论构造具体且含非微扰Dirac海效应，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 引力手征夸克孤子模型的孤子解：广义相对论中的动力学费米子与Dirac海
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究基于静态球对称时空上与非线手征场耦合的Dirac费米子的Einstein-Dirac系统。考察了引力对费米子动力学质量的影响。手征夸克孤子模型（CQSM）最初是受大$N_\textrm{c}$ QCD低能区启发而提出的强子模型，它通过完整包含Dirac海实现费米子的局域化，而Dirac海源自正则化的单费米子圈。我们将CQSM推广到球对称弯曲时空并与Einstein引力耦合。我们成功地自洽求解了CQSM与Einstein方程，并得到了费米子能量以及ADM质量的谱流。Dirac海稀释了能量-动量张量的效应，这导致即使存在局域化物质时，引力影响也会出现一个不活跃点。对于更大的动力学质量$M\sim \langle\barψψ\rangle$，Dirac海效应变得占主导，导致出现负的ADM质量。
